title: Intervals Between Identical Elements
summary: Given an array of n integers, create an array where each element is the sum of the absolute differences between its index and the indices of all other elements with the same value.
statement: Given an array of n integers, create an array where each element is the sum of the absolute differences between its index and the indices of all other elements with the same value.
constraints: For each index, sum its absolute distance to every other index holding the same value.
The element at the index contributes zero and duplicates are handled independently.
Return one distance sum per original index.
hints: Within each value group, sorted indices let left and right absolute differences be computed from sums.
Group positions, then sweep each group while maintaining the sum of earlier indices and the total sum.
All earlier indices are at most i and later indices at least i, so removing absolute values yields exactly these two formulas.

tests.explanation: Indices zero, two, and three holding ten have sums five, three, and four.
